subject: Re: AtlasBank security gate sprint — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention clarifications
messages:
From: Margaret Jensen <margaret.jensen@atlasbank.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@atlasbank.com>, procurement@atlasbank.com
Date: 2026-10-11T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Security gate sprint — initial ask

Hannah,

Thanks for the MAP draft you sent last week. Before we lock dates on the sprint I need to align a few security items with our legal and procurement teams:

- SOC 2: we need scope confirmation (prod only vs prod+staging) and the latest set of controls you map to ASC 3.
- SIG / CAIQ: if you can provide a filled CAIQ or a spreadsheet of responses that would speed the review.
- DPA: procurement has a few non-standard data residency bullets — I'll attach the list.
- Data retention: we're aiming for a 7-year read-only archive for certain transaction logs; please confirm retention tiers and export mechanics.

Can you confirm a target date for a security walkthrough (30–40 minute) the week of Oct 18? Our compliance lead (Samir) will join.

Thanks,
Margaret

--
Margaret Jensen
Head of Vendor Risk Management
AtlasBank
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Margaret Jensen <margaret.jensen@atlasbank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security gate sprint — initial ask

Margaret — thanks for the clear list. Quick responses below and attaching a MAP draft that aligns the items to sprint milestones.

- SOC 2 scope: production-only by default; we can include a limited staging assessment for the specific ingestion pipeline if that helps accelerate acceptance. We will provide the SOC 2 matrix (control IDs + evidence owners) by Oct 14.
- SIG / CAIQ: we have a pre-filled CAIQ (vendor assessment) and an internal XLS version with evidence links; attaching the XLS in the next message.
- DPA: appreciate the procurement bullets. Neha is owning the DPA redline; Kimberly will weigh in on carve-outs. Expect a redline v2 by Oct 13.
- Retention: short answer — tiered retention. Transaction logs: 7-year WORM export available; by default logs are 90 days hot, 2 years warm, then archived to cold storage with retrieval SLA. I'll include export mechanics in the MAP under the Data Lifecycle section.

Proposed walkthrough times: Oct 19 at 09:30 PT or Oct 20 at 14:00 PT. Which works for your team?

Attached: MAP_Gate_Sprint_Draft.odt (gate alignment + owners).

Best,
Hannah
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Margaret Jensen <margaret.jensen@atlasbank.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: DPA redline and KMS clarification

Hi Margaret — forwarding our legal team's working redline. Two quick clarifications to note:

1) Key management: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via our KMS integration (AWS KMS + BYOK flows). For AtlasBank's residency constraints, we can ensure key material never leaves the chosen region; we'll document the flow and provide operational runbooks during the walkthrough.

2) Retention carveouts: the current redline preserves standard logging for security investigations (30 days hot) while allowing your 7-year archival requirement as a paid retention tier. If AtlasBank needs guaranteed WORM retention for regulatory audit, that will be scoped as an addendum to the DPA (cost/operational impact included).

Attaching: Redwood_DPA_redline_v2.pdf (redline highlights included).

-Neha
Sr. PM, Compliance Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Margaret Jensen <margaret.jensen@atlasbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@atlasbank.com>, procurement@atlasbank.com
Date: 2026-10-13T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redline and KMS clarification

Thanks Neha — that helps. A few procurement notes:

- Procurement wants the DPA redline with the retention addendum text on our letterhead so our legal can run an internal sign-off; can you generate the addendum language we referenced and share a doc link?
- The KMS flow looks good. We will want explicit audit evidence of key rotation and region-bound material; can you confirm the logs/format?
- Walkthrough: Oct 19 09:30 PT works for us. Please send an invite with a short agenda.

Margaret

On Oct 12, 2026, at 08:05, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Margaret — forwarding our legal team's working redline. Two quick clarifications to note: ...
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Margaret Jensen <margaret.jensen@atlasbank.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T11:50:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood DPA redline + SIG tracker (attachment)

Margaret / team — attaching the formal redline and a quick SIG tracker I compiled that maps each CAIQ question to an evidence artifact (SOC 2 report sections, runbooks, encryption docs). Highlights:

- We added explicit language for AtlasBank's archival SLA and acceptance criteria (see Section 7 addendum).
- Evidence format: audit logs for KMS operations are CSV/JSON with RFC3339 timestamps; we can deliver via secure SharePoint link or SFTP per your preference.
- SIG answers: Wherever we note a partial control (e.g., physical security for on-prem partners), we've flagged compensating controls.

Attachments: AtlasBank_SIG_Responses_v1.xlsx, Redwood_DPA_redline_v2.pdf

Let me know if legal wants tracked changes rather than redline; happy to convert.

Kimberly Park
Lead Counsel, Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Margaret Jensen <margaret.jensen@atlasbank.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood DPA redline + SIG tracker (attachment)

All — this is excellent, thank you. A couple of final coordination items before the walkthrough on Oct 19:

- Procurement will circulate the DPA addendum template on Monday; once we have the exact language we'll route the DocuSign. HubSpot deal owner is Sara Lee and will attach the DocuSign link to the deal (we'll share).
- Compliance execs want a 45-minute walkthrough focused on two things: KMS audit evidence (10 minutes) and the retention/export mechanics for the 7-year archive (25 minutes), followed by Q&A. Can Redwood prepare a short demo or runbook excerpt for the export path?
- Please provide the CAIQ XLS + the SOC 2 control-to-evidence matrix in advance (we've flagged 6 controls for immediate review).

We'll see you Oct 19 09:30 PT — invite coming from our side.

Best,
Margaret
Head of Vendor Risk Management
AtlasBank
